steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The practical component is worth 60% of the total GCSE — performance and choreography combined | Key Fact: Performance (30%) includes one solo and one duet/trio performance of set phrases | Key Fact: Choreography (30%) requires a solo or group choreography in response to a chosen stimulus | Key Fact: Performance marks reward technical accuracy, physical skills, expressive skills and mental skills

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from practical exam technique, and one past-paper question.
